name: Kinetic Invocation — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Kinetic Invocation from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Kinetic Invocation", "Kinetic Invocation" but are not part of the Kinetic Invocation entry, which is unchanged.
